class.name: MaszynaParser
class.brief_description: Parser for .e3d MaSzyna files. Reads meshes and creates them in Godot.
class.description: This class provides a parser for the ".e3d" MaSzyna's file format. It reads mesh data from these files and generates corresponding mesh objects suitable for use within the Godot game engine. The parser uses a token-based approach for efficient processing of the input file. It uses helper methods for low-level data reading, token manipulation, and higher-level mesh data extraction. The parser also supports a metadata stack for handling nested structures in the input file and allows registering custom handlers for specific tokens.

method.name: as_bool
method.description: Converts a token to a boolean value.

method.name: as_vector3
method.description: Converts an array of tokens to a Vector3.

method.name: clear_metadata
method.description: Clears the internal metadata stack.

method.name: eof_reached
method.description: Checks if the end of the file has been reached.

method.name: get8
method.description: Reads and returns a single byte from the input stream.

method.name: get_length
method.description: Returns the size of the parsed buffer in bytes.

method.name: get_line
method.description: Reads and returns the next line from the input stream.

method.name: get_parsed_metadata
method.description: Returns the currently parsed metadata.

method.name: get_position
method.description: Returns the current read position in the buffer, in bytes.

method.name: get_tokens
method.description: Reads and returns a specified number of tokens.

method.name: get_tokens_until
method.description: Reads tokens until a specified token is encountered.

method.name: initialize
method.description: Initializes the parser with the file data.

method.name: interrupt
method.description: Called from a handler: makes the running [method parse_chunk] return right after that handler, e.g. to continue parsing in another (included) file first.

method.name: next_token
method.description: Reads and returns the next token.

method.name: next_vector3
method.description: Reads and returns the next Vector3.

method.name: parse
method.description: Parses the entire file and returns the extracted mesh data.

method.name: parse_chunk
method.description: Parses tokens until at least [param bytes] bytes have been read or the end of the buffer is reached, and returns the objects produced by the handlers. A handler may read past the limit. Call repeatedly until [method eof_reached] to parse the whole buffer in chunks, e.g. to report progress with [method get_position] and [method get_length].

method.name: pop_metadata
method.description: Pops and returns metadata from the stack.

method.name: push_metadata
method.description: Pushes metadata onto the stack.

method.name: register_handler
method.description: Registers a custom handler for a specific token.

method.name: set_parameters
method.description: Sets custom parameters for the parser that can be used during the parsing process.

method.name: unregister_handler
method.description: Unregisters a previously registered custom handler for a specific token.
